title: Prove exact outward norm slack from affine periods and classify the conserved-sum Gaussian pair family
body:
## Result
Prove that a full-rank affine-period rounder has worst outward norm increment equal to its maximum coset error. For every legal bounded-center Gaussian pair rule, the exact slack is sup |c(s)| and the family minimum is one. Source corollaries retain their original certificate premises.

## Checks and scope
Eight exact source pins; normal and optimized source replays; a separate exact-rational checker and alternate proof. Finite witnesses include dyadic unit-ball crossings. Unrestricted optimality and physical/caller admission remain open. No new kappa; all five selected assumptions remain.

[Complete description, exact pins, reproduction and limitations](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/76811d7c2621c2a186776a1a31cbe223a52b76bc/research/affine-period-outward-slack/PR-DRAFT.md).
